content.thinking: Interesting: constant-folding overflow is a hard compile error, but *runtime* overflow behavior depends on debug_assertions. Let me test runtime overflow with a non-const value.

cd /workspace/dev/tmp && cat > ovf2.rs <<'EOF'
fn main(){ let a:u32=std::env::var("X").unwrap_or_default().parse().unwrap_or(0u32); let c=a-1; println!("{}",c); }
EOF
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rust/lib TMPDIR=/workspace/dev/tmp /opt/rust/bin/rustc --edition=2021 --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -C opt-level=2 -C codegen-units=1 -A warnings -C linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld ovf2.rs -o ovf2 2>&1|head -5; X=0 ./ovf2; echo "rc=$?"
